1. Be findable for the searches that matter

Your BeautyFlow page is built to rank for “your name menu”, “restaurants in your area” and the dishes you serve. Structured data tells Google it is a restaurant with a menu, prices and opening hours.

2. Remove friction from ordering

Every dish has a WhatsApp button and customers can build a full order and send it in one message. No app downloads, no accounts.

3. Promote offers where people are looking

Special offers appear at the top of your page and on your listing card. Pair them with a WhatsApp status or Instagram post that links to your page.

4. Share the link everywhere

Put your beautyflow.co.ke link on Google Business Profile, Instagram bio, Facebook page, WhatsApp Business catalogue and printed QR cards. One link, always current.

5. Know what sells

The optional POS module shows daily, weekly and monthly sales, payment breakdown and top dishes — so you promote what works.
